summary: Stores a mode byte at this+0x2 and a DWORD parameter at this+0x48, then loads the pit crew mesh via PitCrewMeshLoader(this, a4, a5, a6, 0). When the DWORD guard at this+0x64 (fill label: 3D sound-source handle, DERIVED) is non-zero, adjusts runtime flags through FlagFieldBitManipulation, using (1, 1, 0, 0) when the stored mode byte is non-zero and (0, 0, 0, 0) when it is zero. Returns the flag-manipulation result in that guarded path, otherwise the mesh-loader result.

operations.description: result = PitCrewMeshLoader(this, a4, a5, a6, 0): load the pit crew mesh into the object.
If *(DWORD*)(this+0x64) is non-zero (fill label: 3D sound-source handle present, DERIVED), enter the flag-adjust path; otherwise return the mesh loader result.
When the stored mode byte at this+0x2 is non-zero, FlagFieldBitManipulation(1, 1, 0, 0).
When the stored mode byte at this+0x2 is zero, FlagFieldBitManipulation(0, 0, 0, 0).
Return the FlagFieldBitManipulation result from the guarded path, or the mesh loader result when the guard field at this+0x64 is zero.

unresolved: The meaning of PitCrewMeshLoader arguments a4/a5/a6 is not named in the packet; the fill only describes them as mesh-loader inputs.
The guard at this+0x64 as a 3D sound-source handle is a fill claim (DERIVED); the raw source only reads the field as a non-zero guard.
The meaning of FlagFieldBitManipulation's (1, 1, 0, 0) / (0, 0, 0, 0) argument tuples is not documented in the packet.
The packet ABI legacy name Mode_Dependent_Subsystem_Call (LEGACY trust) is generic and not used as the proposal.
